product_one_liner.value: Syren helps enterprises modernize data platforms and deploy governed analytics, machine-learning models and AI agents to automate workflows and improve business decisions.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing navigation or plans found; the pricing endpoint yielded no page, and commercial inquiries are directed to contact sales.

named_customers.notes: The readable case-study index describes customers anonymously; image labels and filenames alone do not establish two named customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 392 employees; the requested band is based on that count, not a broader company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes technical architecture articles, but the reviewed how-built posts are credited to Syren Editorial rather than identified engineers; two qualifying engineer-authored posts were not established.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found on the company site; product and service pages are not documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior ML/AI Engineer is marked Active opening. This is a third-party live listing, not the company’s own ATS.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly named for RAG-based SQL agents and natural-language interfaces; no inference about their underlying model vendors is made.

compliance_certs.notes: The company profile claims these certifications; the website qualifies its wording as ISO 27001:2013, SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA-aligned practices. These are public claims, not independent verification; GDPR and HIPAA alignment is not equivalent to an audited certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile, updated October 17, 2026, labels Syren unfunded and explicitly says it has not raised any funding rounds; date and amount are not applicable.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding rounds reported; assessed for May 9, 2025 through November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable inventory of 22 current openings contains no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title. Broader sales-management roles do not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: July 2, 2026: Syren presented TrueTrack, its production real-time order-visibility portal built on Databricks Lakebase, inside the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: May 25, 2026: Syren announced Rajib Chakrabarti joining as Vice President—Global Sales, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job listing and job inventory do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system used by Syren; generic Salesforce examples in marketing articles do not establish internal usage.
